hello.simpleMeaning: A nice way to say hi to someone
hello.contextMeaning: A friendly greeting when someone arrives or starts talking

contest.contextMeaning: It is a competition where people try to win
contest.sentence: Eurovision is a famous TV song contest in Europe.

perform.simpleMeaning: To do something for people to watch
perform.contextMeaning: To sing a song for everyone to see and hear
perform.sentence: In this contest, many countries send one act to perform a song.

jury.simpleMeaning: A group of people who decide
jury.contextMeaning: A small group of people who choose the winner
jury.sentence: It is also a competition with public votes and jury votes.

feel.contextMeaning: To seem or be experienced as special
feel.sentence: Eurovision can feel special for new learners.

special.contextMeaning: Different and important in a good way
special.sentence: Eurovision can feel special for new learners.

stage.simpleMeaning: A place where people sing or dance
stage.contextMeaning: The raised platform where the singers and dancers perform
stage.sentence: Countries perform original songs on a big stage.

viewers.simpleMeaning: People who watch something on TV or online
viewers.contextMeaning: The people watching the show on television or on the internet
viewers.sentence: Then viewers and music experts help choose the winner.

people.contextMeaning: Many individuals who are watching the show
people.sentence: That is why many people follow it with excitement.

semifinal.simpleMeaning: It is a game before the last game
semifinal.contextMeaning: It is a game before the very last game, where countries compete
semifinal.sentence: On Thursday, 15 countries performed in the second semifinal.

final.simpleMeaning: It is the very last game or contest
final.contextMeaning: It is the very last game or contest where the winner is.
final.sentence: A semifinal is a round before the final.

qualify.simpleMeaning: To be good enough to go to the next.
qualify.contextMeaning: To be good enough to move on to the next part of the contest.
qualify.sentence: In this round, only 10 countries could qualify.

atmosphere.simpleMeaning: How a place feels, like happy or sad
atmosphere.contextMeaning: The feeling or mood in the big room was very strong
atmosphere.sentence: The atmosphere in the arena was intense.

arena.simpleMeaning: A big place where people watch sports
arena.contextMeaning: The big building where the show or contest is happening
arena.sentence: The atmosphere in the arena was intense.
